summary: Alvotech filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, reporting the closing of an underwritten public offering of 26,066,667 ordinary shares at $3.75 per share, including full exercise of the underwriters' option, raising $98M in gross proceeds. Concurrently, it closed a private placement of 17,826,666 shares at the same price. The filing is a routine capital-raising event, not a special situation. It does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change.
